summary: The weighted-density counterexample is correct as stated. Checks of n=1, p=4, the infinite-power endpoint, and the cap boundary produce no counterexample. The log-concavity and integrability claims, fiber integrals, absolute convergence of the barycentric sums, and unique maximizing reflection center follow from the stated calculations. The product weights give the asserted mean and uniform height bound. The indicator estimate has the correct direction and yields exactly e^3 times exp(-delta n) after division by 2^{-n}W. The positivity certificate is exact: the exponential-series partial sum is 12013/6000, and the final rational difference is 443/57800. The common halfspace supplies the depth upper bound uniformly over all permitted exponents, including dimension-dependent choices. The conclusion is correctly restricted to the specified density model and selection rules.
